title: Melt Curve Viewer

author.name: delahny
author.field: Molecular biology / qPCR (SYBR melt-curve analysis, Bio-Rad CFX Maestro exports)

provenance.origin: github.com/delahny/melt-curve-viewer at 19845ee495c1, personal (personal: "qpcr" "web app" in:readme,description archived:false (page 2))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Upload a CFX Maestro melt-curve RFU export (plus an optional sample-name file), plot every well's raw melt curve or its -d(RFU)/dT derivative, and pick wells from a searchable, sortable table to compare Tm and find problem wells. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
